issues.description: Extraction unconditionally requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, so the advertised tiny demo and integration test fail from a fresh checkout.
Story loading has no built-in generation or fallback despite README claims, making the repo unable to reproduce vectors without absent source data.
HuggingFace model/tokenizer downloads are unpinned by revision, creating non-reproducible and potentially risky production runs.
HF tokenization/inference has no max length or truncation controls, so long story inputs can cause excessive memory use or OOM.
If offset mapping is unavailable or activity matching fails, steering falls back to every token in the prompt instead of only the activity tokens.
Vector artifacts are trusted without checking backend, model, layer count, d_model, or vector shape compatibility before validation.
Preference steering loads vector artifacts without schema or shape validation, allowing mismatched artifacts to produce invalid results or opaque crashes.
The configured neutral_corpus setting is ignored; extraction always uses the hard-coded built-in neutral transcripts.
Config values are not validated, so empty emotion lists, invalid counts, and out-of-range fractions fail later with unclear errors.
A PCA variance threshold of 0 returns one component instead of zero components, which contradicts the threshold semantics.
Checked-in tiny output metadata references a larger 16-emotion source manifest, making the generated artifacts stale or non-reproducible from current repo contents.
The documented tiny CPU demo commands do not work from a fresh checkout because required source stories are not present.
